events.verdict: Green (GSW) establishes himself in George's (UTA) path and does not deliver illegal contact while setting the pick.
Curry (GSW) moves alongside George's (UTA) path and retreats his arms to a vertical position as he absorbs the marginal contact during the driving shot attempt.
Wiggins (GSW) collapses his left arm against his body as he absorbs the initial contact with Sexton (UTA), who then raises his off-arm up and the contact during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
Green (GSW) firms up in George's (UTA) path and marginal contact occurs as George defends over the pick.
George (UTA) moves alongside Curry's (GSW) path and absorbs the marginal contact during the drive.
George (UTA) slides laterally into Curry's (GSW) path and body contact occurs that affects Curry's SQBR during the drive.
Thompson (GSW) moves alongside George's (UTA) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
George (UTA) leaves both feet and goes into the air after gathering the ball and returns to the ground while still in possession of the ball.
Green's (GSW) left arm comes out slightly and marginal brush contact occurs with Sexton (UTA) as the two players engage and disengage away from the ball.
Sexton (UTA) legally contests Thompson's (GSW) jump shot attempt.
Wiggins (GSW) brings his arm toward the ball and the contact with Markkanen (UTA) is marginal.
Sexton (UTA) establishes himself in Thompson's (GSW) path and absorbs the marginal contact as the two players come together during the pick.
Collins (UTA) goes to the ground in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs with Wiggins (GSW) as he secures the ball.
Sexton (UTA) contests Thompson's (GSW) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Thompson (GSW) moves alongside George's (UTA) path and marginal contact occurs during George's drive toward the paint.
Wiggins (GSW) legally contests Markkanen's (UTA) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Collins (UTA) makes last contact with the ball prior to it falling out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to Golden State.
George (UTA) commits a take foul on Curry (GSW). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Collins' (UTA) arms come out slightly as he firms up in Podziemski's (GSW) path and the contact during the screen is marginal.
